messages:
Marta (CSM): Quick thread — EBR for Acme in 4 days. Need owners for: slide pack, short risk slide, demo runbook, onboarding snapshot, and a fast ROI example. Keep replies short pls.
Priya (Onboarding): I27ll do onboarding snapshot: ingest %, passes, outstanding blockers. Current: ingest 82%, eval pass 91%, blockers: Okta SSO cert rotation + analytics RBAC.
Evan (Acme): SSO cert rotated yesterday on our IdP, so metadata changed. I27ll send the new metadata XML now. Also execs want focus on cost predictability + uptime.
Lenora (Solutions): I will own the demo. Plan: 6-min live flow (catalog ingestion -> search -> rerank) + perf slide showing p50/p95. Need a stable demo key and dataset pointer. @Evan confirm access to 'catalog-v3'.
Jordan (Product): I27ll prepare roadmap + ROI slide. ROI calc will be two bullets + simple math: time saved * queries/month * $/hour. Will add a tiny sensitivity table.
Amir (CS Dir): Renewal note: ACV coming up in 9 months, sponsor changed. Suggest one-slide "Renewal Runway" with sponsor list, health indicators, and proposed exec ask (1: intro call, 2: cost review, 3: pilot extension).
Marta (CSM): Sounds good. Action list: Priya (onboard slide) due EOD tomorrow; Lenora (demo runbook + commands) due in 24h; Jordan (roadmap + ROI) due tomorrow noon; Amir (risk/runway slide) draft by EOD tomorrow. Evan confirm dataset and whether execs want pre-brief.
Evan (Acme): Dataset = catalog-v3, yes they want a 15-min pre-brief the day before (will take 10).
Marta (CSM): Scheduling pre-brief. @deploy-bot please create 15-min pre-brief event and invite Acme execs + our leads.
deploy-bot: Event created  Acme EBR pre-brief  2024-06-20 15:00 UTC. Invites sent.
Priya (Onboarding): Okta metadata received. One hiccup: their AssertionConsumerService URL uses an IP alias which our IdP mapping rejects. Escalating to eng-infra; ETA 6 hours. If fixed today, I can finish SSO mapping tonight.
Lenora (Solutions): Demo runbook snippet (to paste into deck notes):
```
# Demo runbook (condensed)
1) Use demo key: acme_demo_tmp
2) Ingest small sample: aws s3 sync s3://acme/catalog-v3 ./data --profile acme-demo
3) Run inference check:
   curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"catalog latency check"}'
   expect p95 < 200ms
4) Validate rerank sample: run ./scripts/rerank_test.sh catalog_sample.json
```
Jordan (Product): For ROI slide I27ll include: baseline cost per query, projected cost w/ batching & cache, and net monthly savings. Any objections to exposing cost numbers?
Amir (CS Dir): Fine to show ranges. Keep figures high level (no raw per-token invoicing). Include a short note about assumptions.
Marta (CSM): Rehearsal slot tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Drop your slide bullets into the deck notes (link: https://docs.google.com/example). Also add 1-2 rehearsal talking points.
Evan (Acme): Execs want reliability examples 26 an incident timeline for last quarter. Can you add a short appendix?
Lenora (Solutions): Will add 1-slide appendix with uptime, incident count, MTTR.
Priya (Onboarding): One more blocker: analytics RBAC requires a mapping table from Acme teams to roles. Evan can you share the team email list?
Evan (Acme): Sharing team list now.
Marta (CSM): Thanks. Final: please keep messages short and paste bullets into deck notes. Will post the run-of-show after rehearsal. :thumbsup:
